budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Tocci said he had already paid National Grid for the gas connection.

budget_items.topic: Complete Streets technical assistance and funding
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Benevento said technical assistance up to $50,000 is available, and that only six communities have been awarded construction funding out of $12.5 million available to date.
budget_items.quote: technical assistance up to $50,000 is available by completing the required documentation.

budget_items.topic: Storm Water Task Force scope of services bids
budget_items.what_was_recorded: VHB bid $21,300 and DCI with the MA Watershed Coalition bid $18,800 for the scope of services; the Board accepted the low bid.
budget_items.quote: came in at $21,300 and design consultants, inc. (dci) in conjunction with the massachusetts watershed coalition came in at $18,800.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board signed a payroll deduction warrant, a payroll warrant, an accounts payable warrant and a middle/high school building construction warrant.
budget_items.quote: the board signed a payroll deduction warrant in the amount of $506,461.23, a payroll warrant in the amount of $758,613.05

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Three larger capacity buses were added at $15,000 each and a new bus at $56,000; $101,000 is to come from the private tuition line surplus; regular and special education transportation is over $1,000,000.
budget_items.quote: three larger capacity school buses have been added due to increased enrollment at the cost of $15,000 per bus

budget_items.topic: Pratt St., Pine Grove Road and Cross Road betterments
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Sewer Commission betterments will be less than $14,000, compared with the previously quoted $23,000.
budget_items.quote: it will be less than $14,000 compared to the previously quoted amount of $23,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: MART offered to lease the van to the town for $1 per year if member towns assume auto insurance for the vans.
budget_items.quote: they are willing to lease the van to the town for $1 per year in order to make that work.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Towns will be reimbursed up to $2000 annually based on invoices for van insurance.
budget_items.quote: towns will be reimbursed up to $2000 annually based on invoices.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Assessors reported $160,000 in new growth not yet certified by DOR; if no action is taken it goes to FY 2018 free cash, and a Special Town Meeting could raise and appropriate it for this fiscal year.
budget_items.quote: mr. marciello stated the assessors have reported $160,000 in new growth but it has not been certified by dor
